findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "İsimli magnetler, kapı süsleri ve pasta süsleri." → 4 lines (7 words, 87px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Portakal Çiçeği Atölye" above "İsimli magnetler, kapı süsleri ve pasta "; "Ürünlere bak" above "✳"; "Atölyeden" above "Ürünler"; "Setler" above "İsimli magnetler ve kapı süsleri"; "Pasta süsleri" above "Fotoğraflı pasta süsü setleri"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 6 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Portakal Çiçeği Atölye", "Atölyeden", "Setler", "Pasta süsleri").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✳
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.Celebration_heroPaper__pAIcA → rgba(118, 86, 56, 0.07) 0px 12px 36px 0px | a.Celebration_heroInset__L8kJp → rgba(100, 75, 52, 0.125) 0px 6px 30px 0px | div.Celebration_storyMedia__ZDwXW → rgba(106, 80, 49, 0.063) 0px 6px 22px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.border-b.border-[#e5d8c6] 1440px | header.sticky.top-0 1440px | section#urunler.Celebration_container__Iu0hO.Celebration_pro 1280px | section#surec.Celebration_container__Iu0hO.Celebration_proce 1280px

findings.message: 1 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (page background #fdfbf7, section #fdfbf7, section #f0eee5, section #fffcf5).

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "© 2026 Portakal Çiçeği Atölye" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Gizlilik politikası" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Sipariş koşulları" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "gizlilik politikamızda" 3.5:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: 46 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Pasta ve kürdan süsleri" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
